description: The displayed shell-rank formula is a bijection from natural-number pairs to natural numbers and preserves and reflects maximum-first order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank_order_iso :
  Function.Bijective Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank ∧
    ∀ (p q : ℕ × ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareLT p q ↔
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank p <
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.shellRank q
